items.t: Transfer case oil leak can lock the wheels (recall)
items.job: Inspect, reseal and refill or replace transfer case (recall 02V143)
items.note: Free at a Mitsubishi dealer if the recall is open. A leak after the recall is paid work.

items.t: Transfer case or output shaft failure
items.job: Replace transfer case with remanufactured unit (or replace output shaft)
items.note: A remanufactured transfer case sells for about $1,260-$1,560 plus a refundable core charge. A blown center coupling can mean a $1,200-$2,500 transmission rebuild.

items.t: 6-speed manual grinding, jumping gears or failing
items.job: Rebuild or replace 6-speed manual transmission
items.note: One owner was quoted about $4,414 in parts plus $696 labor for a new transmission; another paid $3,000 for a replacement. Synchro repair alone starts around $1,000.

items.t: Timing belt breaks or slips
items.job: Replace timing belt, tensioner, idler and water pump
items.note: YourMechanic estimates about $1,453-$1,672. Engine damage from a broken belt costs far more.

items.t: Front seat belts won't retract
items.job: Replace front seat belt retractor
items.note: One owner was quoted about 2.5 hours and $500 to swap a belt. Used belts are common.

items.t: Engine knock from a spun bearing
items.job: Replace engine with used or rebuilt unit
items.note: 3SWiki lists about $2,000-$3,000 for a used or rebuilt engine.

items.t: Turbo oil seals leak and smoke
items.job: Replace both turbochargers
items.note: New stock-style turbos sell for about $750 each or $980 a pair. Labor is high because the rear turbo is buried behind the engine.

items.t: Lifter tick
items.job: Replace hydraulic lifters
items.note: 3SWiki lists $120-$350 and up for lifters.

items.t: Oil leak from the valve covers
items.job: Replace valve cover gaskets
items.note: YourMechanic estimates about $287 for 1997-1998 and $425 for 1996 VR-4.

items.t: Chrome wheels peel and tires lose air
items.job: Reseal tire bead or replace corroded wheel
items.note: 3SWiki lists $200-$750 per wheel. Bead sealing is the low end.

items.t: Automatic transmission shifts late or slips
items.job: Automatic transmission fluid service and diagnosis
items.note: RepairPal lists about $193-$285 for a fluid change. A rebuild for worn internal clutches costs much more.

items.t: Clutch slipping or dragging
items.job: Replace clutch kit
items.note: RepairPal lists about $1,586-$1,945. Flywheel work costs extra.

items.t: Power steering leaks
items.job: Replace power steering hose or steering rack
items.note: YourMechanic estimates about $1,238 for a non-turbo rack and $2,654-$2,687 for a VR-4. A hose costs far less.

items.t: Rear-wheel steering fluid leak
items.job: Replace rear steering linkages or seals
items.note: 3SWiki lists about $100 for the common linkage fix.

items.t: Long cranking, stumbling and stalling when cold
items.job: Diagnose cold-start problem and perform bulletin repair

items.t: Fuel starvation from a clogged in-tank filter
items.job: Replace fuel pump and in-tank filter
items.note: YourMechanic estimates about $600-$800.

items.t: Fuel smell from a leaking fuel sender
items.job: Repair fuel line at sending unit
items.note: 3SWiki lists $10-$100 in parts.

items.t: Engine computer fails from leaking capacitors
items.job: Recap or replace engine computer
items.note: 3SWiki lists $40-$300. The climate control repair takes about 4 hours more.

items.t: Water leaks into the cabin
items.job: Water-leak test, reseal and dry carpet

items.t: Shaking when braking or brakes pulling
items.job: Replace brake caliper or pads and rotors
items.note: YourMechanic estimates about $540-$940 per caliper and $365-$380 for pads.

items.t: Power window grinds or drops
items.job: Replace window regulator and motor
items.note: YourMechanic estimates about $817-$828 for 1999 cars.

items.t: Active exhaust valve stuck
items.job: Replace rear exhaust section with valve
items.note: 3SWiki lists $350-$1,500.

items.t: Bouncy ride or pulling from worn struts
items.job: Replace struts (pair)
items.note: YourMechanic estimates about $1,271-$1,656 per axle.
